scripts.build: pnpm --filter @story-pilot/contracts build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/presets build && vite build
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @story-pilot/contracts build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/presets build && vite build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @story-pilot/contracts build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/presets build && vitest run src
